name: Multimodal Species Recognition Agent
description: Identifies an animal species from one supplied photograph paired with a text instruction, using image-vector retrieval against a reference collection. Covers determining which species appears in a supplied photograph, answering 'what animal is this' about an image the user provides, and listing visually similar species from the same retrieval. Requires BOTH an image and a non-empty text instruction in the same request - it cannot identify a species from a text description alone, and it cannot accept an image with no instruction. Returns identified, uncertain or not_identified; an inconclusive result is a real answer, not a failure.
managed_services: BioCLIP-2 (officially selected; execution mocked in Sprint 2)
